content: In Capernaum, how many men carried the paralyzed man to Jesus?
explanation: His friends carried him on a mat. “Then a paralytic was brought to Him, carried by four men.” (Mark 2:3, BSB)

content: Why did the paralyzed man's friends open up the roof of the house?
explanation: The house was packed with people. “Since they were unable to get to Jesus through the crowd, they uncovered the roof above Him” (Mark 2:4, BSB)

content: How did the friends get the paralyzed man to Jesus in the crowded house?
explanation: Nothing stopped them from bringing their friend to Jesus. “made an opening, and lowered the paralytic on his mat.” (Mark 2:4, BSB)

content: When Jesus saw the friends' faith, what did He first say to the paralyzed man?
explanation: Jesus cared about his heart first. “Son, your sins are forgiven.” (Mark 2:5, BSB)

content: When Jesus forgave the paralyzed man, who did the scribes say alone can forgive sins?
explanation: Jesus showed He has God's authority. “Who can forgive sins but God alone?” (Mark 2:7, BSB)

content: What did Jesus tell the healed paralyzed man to pick up and take home?
explanation: The man walked out in front of everyone. “get up, pick up your mat, and go home.” (Mark 2:11, BSB)

content: After the paralyzed man walked out healed, what did the amazed crowd say?
explanation: They glorified God. “We have never seen anything like this!” (Mark 2:12, BSB)

content: When Jesus and His disciples crossed the sea one evening, what came up?
explanation: Waves broke over the boat. “Soon a violent windstorm came up” (Mark 4:37, BSB)

content: During the storm on the sea, what was Jesus doing in the boat?
explanation: He was not afraid of the storm. “But Jesus was in the stern, sleeping on the cushion.” (Mark 4:38, BSB)

content: When the disciples woke Jesus in the storm, what did they ask Him?
options: Don't You care we are perishing?
explanation: They were terrified. “Teacher, don’t You care that we are perishing?” (Mark 4:38, BSB)

content: In the storm, what did Jesus say to the wind and the sea?
explanation: Even the weather obeys Him. ““Silence!” He commanded. “Be still!”” (Mark 4:39, BSB)

content: After Jesus rebuked the wind on the sea, what happened?
explanation: The storm stopped at His word. “And the wind died down, and it was perfectly calm.” (Mark 4:39, BSB)

content: After calming the storm, what did Jesus ask His disciples?
explanation: He wanted them to have faith. ““Why are you so afraid?” He asked.” (Mark 4:40, BSB)

content: After Jesus stopped the storm, what did the disciples ask one another?
options: Who is this that the wind obeys?
explanation: They were amazed at His power. “Who is this, that even the wind and the sea obey Him?” (Mark 4:41, BSB)

content: What was Jairus, the man who fell at Jesus' feet and begged for help?
explanation: He came for his sick daughter. “A synagogue leader named Jairus arrived” (Mark 5:22, BSB)

content: Why did Jairus beg Jesus to come to his house?
explanation: He believed Jesus could heal her. “My little daughter is near death.” (Mark 5:23, BSB)

content: While Jesus was on the way to Jairus's house, what news arrived?
explanation: The messengers thought it was too late. “Your daughter is dead; why bother the Teacher anymore?” (Mark 5:35, BSB)

content: When Jairus heard his daughter had died, what did Jesus tell him?
options: Do not be afraid; just believe
explanation: Jesus was about to do the impossible. “Do not be afraid; just believe.” (Mark 5:36, BSB)

content: At Jairus's house, what did Jesus say about the girl?
options: She is not dead, but asleep
explanation: For Jesus, death was like sleep. “The child is not dead, but asleep.” (Mark 5:39, BSB)

content: When Jesus said Jairus's daughter was only asleep, how did the mourners react?
explanation: They knew she had died. “And they laughed at Him.” (Mark 5:40, BSB)

content: How old was Jairus's daughter when Jesus raised her?
explanation: She got up and walked around. “She was twelve years old” (Mark 5:42, BSB)

content: After raising Jairus's daughter, what did Jesus tell them to give her?
explanation: She was truly alive and hungry. “and He told them to give her something to eat.” (Mark 5:43, BSB)

content: As Jesus was leaving which city did He meet blind Bartimaeus by the road?
explanation: Bartimaeus sat by the road begging. “as Jesus and His disciples were leaving Jericho” (Mark 10:46, BSB)

content: What did blind Bartimaeus cry out when he heard Jesus passing by?
options: Son of David, have mercy on me!
explanation: He believed Jesus was the promised King. ““Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!”” (Mark 10:47, BSB)

content: When people told blind Bartimaeus to be quiet, what did he do?
explanation: He would not give up. “but he cried out all the louder” (Mark 10:48, BSB)

content: When Jesus called him, what did blind Bartimaeus throw off?
explanation: He jumped up and came to Jesus. “Throwing off his cloak, Bartimaeus jumped up and came to Jesus.” (Mark 10:50, BSB)

content: When Jesus asked what he wanted, what did blind Bartimaeus ask for?
explanation: He asked for what only Jesus could give. “let me see again.” (Mark 10:51, BSB)

content: What did Jesus say had healed blind Bartimaeus?
explanation: He trusted Jesus. “your faith has healed you.” (Mark 10:52, BSB)

content: After he could see, what did Bartimaeus do?
explanation: He became a follower of Jesus. “And immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus along the road.” (Mark 10:52, BSB)

content: When people brought little children to Jesus, what did the disciples do?
explanation: They thought Jesus was too busy. “and the disciples rebuked those who brought them.” (Mark 10:13, BSB)

content: How did Jesus feel when the disciples turned the children away?
explanation: Children matter to Jesus. “But when Jesus saw this, He was indignant” (Mark 10:14, BSB)

content: What did Jesus tell His disciples about the little children?
explanation: He told them not to stop the children. “Let the little children come to Me, and do not hinder them!” (Mark 10:14, BSB)

content: When the children came to Him, Jesus said the kingdom of God belongs to whom?
explanation: God welcomes those who come like children. “For the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.” (Mark 10:14, BSB)

content: Blessing the children, Jesus said we must receive God's kingdom like what?
explanation: With simple trust. “anyone who does not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it.” (Mark 10:15, BSB)

content: What did Jesus do with the children who were brought to Him?
explanation: He placed His hands on them. “And He took the children in His arms, placed His hands on them, and blessed them.” (Mark 10:16, BSB)

content: How does the Gospel of Mark open?
options: In the days of King Herod
In the beginning was the Word
A record of the family line
explanation: Mark calls Jesus the Son of God from the start. “This is the beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.” (Mark 1:1, BSB)

content: In Mark, what did Jesus do early in the morning while it was still dark?
options: Went to a solitary place to pray
explanation: Jesus made time to be alone with God. “Jesus got up and slipped out to a solitary place to pray.” (Mark 1:35, BSB)

content: In the region of the Gerasenes, what did the man with the unclean spirit say his name was?
explanation: He said, “for we are many.” ““My name is Legion,” he replied” (Mark 5:9, BSB)

content: When Jesus cast the spirits out of the man called Legion, where did they go?
explanation: The herd rushed into the sea. “the unclean spirits came out and went into the pigs” (Mark 5:13, BSB)

content: How long had the woman who touched Jesus' cloak suffered from bleeding?
explanation: Doctors had not helped her. “And a woman was there who had suffered from bleeding for twelve years.” (Mark 5:25, BSB)

content: What did the sick woman in the crowd believe would heal her?
explanation: Her bleeding stopped at once. “If only I touch His garments, I will be healed.” (Mark 5:28, BSB)

content: What did Jesus tell the woman who was healed by touching His cloak?
explanation: He called her “Daughter.” ““Daughter,” said Jesus, “your faith has healed you.” (Mark 5:34, BSB)

content: In Jesus' hometown, what work did people say He did?
explanation: They took offense at Him. “Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary” (Mark 6:3, BSB)

content: When Jesus sent out the Twelve, how did He send them?
explanation: He gave them authority over unclean spirits. “and began to send them out two by two” (Mark 6:7, BSB)

content: When Jesus healed a deaf man, which Aramaic word did He say?
explanation: It means, “Be opened!” ““Ephphatha!” (which means, “Be opened!”).” (Mark 7:34, BSB)

content: After Jesus first touched the blind man at Bethsaida, what did people look like to him?
explanation: Jesus touched his eyes again and he saw clearly. “but they look like trees walking around.” (Mark 8:24, BSB)

content: Jesus asked what it profits a man to gain the whole world, yet lose what?
explanation: The soul is worth more than the world. “What does it profit a man to gain the whole world, yet forfeit his soul?” (Mark 8:36, BSB)

content: What did the father of the troubled boy cry out to Jesus?
options: I do believe; help my unbelief!
explanation: Jesus had said all things are possible for one who believes. “I do believe; help my unbelief!” (Mark 9:24, BSB)

content: Jesus said whoever wants to be first must be what?
options: Last of all and servant of all
explanation: Greatness in God's kingdom means serving. “he must be the last of all and the servant of all.” (Mark 9:35, BSB)

content: What did Jesus tell the rich young man to do with everything he owned?
options: Sell it and give to the poor
explanation: Then he would have treasure in heaven. “Go, sell everything you own and give to the poor” (Mark 10:21, BSB)

content: Why did the rich young man go away sad after talking with Jesus?
explanation: He loved his riches too much. “because he had great wealth.” (Mark 10:22, BSB)

content: Jesus said the Son of Man came not to be served, but to do what?
options: To serve and give His life
explanation: He gave His life as a ransom for many. “For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many.” (Mark 10:45, BSB)

content: What did the poor widow put into the temple treasury?
explanation: Jesus was watching the givers. “Then one poor widow came and put in two small copper coins” (Mark 12:42, BSB)

content: Why did Jesus say the poor widow gave more than all the others?
explanation: The others gave out of their extra. “but she out of her poverty has put in all she had to live on.” (Mark 12:44, BSB)

content: Who was forced to carry the cross of Jesus?
explanation: He was passing by from the country. “Now Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, was passing by” (Mark 15:21, BSB)

content: On the way to Jesus' tomb, what were the women worried about?
options: Who would roll away the stone
explanation: The stone was very large, but it was already rolled away. “Who will roll away the stone from the entrance of the tomb?” (Mark 16:3, BSB)

content: In Mark, where did the risen Jesus tell His disciples to go and preach the gospel?
explanation: The gospel is for every creature. “Go into all the world and preach the gospel to every creature.” (Mark 16:15, BSB)

content: In which town was the house where the paralyzed man was lowered through the roof?
explanation: Jesus had come back home there. “A few days later Jesus went back to Capernaum.” (Mark 2:1, BSB)

content: During the storm on the sea, in which part of the boat was Jesus sleeping?
explanation: He slept on a cushion. “But Jesus was in the stern, sleeping on the cushion.” (Mark 4:38, BSB)

content: When Jesus met the man called Legion, which region had He sailed to?
explanation: It was on the other side of the sea. “they arrived in the region of the Gerasenes.” (Mark 5:1, BSB)

content: About how many pigs rushed into the sea when the unclean spirits entered them?
explanation: The herd drowned in the water. “and the herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea” (Mark 5:13, BSB)

content: What words did Jesus say when He took Jairus's daughter by the hand?
explanation: It means, “Little girl, get up!” “Jesus said, “Talitha koum!”” (Mark 5:41, BSB)

content: Which disciples did Jesus allow to go with Him to Jairus's house?
explanation: He let no one else come along. “except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.” (Mark 5:37, BSB)

content: Blind Bartimaeus was the son of whom?
explanation: Bar-timaeus means son of Timaeus. “a blind beggar named Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus” (Mark 10:46, BSB)

content: What title did blind Bartimaeus use when he asked Jesus to heal him?
explanation: It means my teacher. ““Rabboni,” said the blind man” (Mark 10:51, BSB)

content: In Bethany, in whose home did a woman pour perfume on Jesus' head?
explanation: Jesus was reclining at the table there. “in the home of Simon the Leper” (Mark 14:3, BSB)

content: What was the expensive perfume poured on Jesus' head in Bethany made of?
explanation: It came in an alabaster jar. “a woman came with an alabaster jar of expensive perfume, made of pure nard.” (Mark 14:3, BSB)

content: Simon of Cyrene, who carried Jesus' cross, was the father of whom?
explanation: Mark's readers may have known his sons. “the father of Alexander and Rufus” (Mark 15:21, BSB)

content: According to Mark, at what hour was Jesus crucified?
explanation: That is about nine in the morning. “It was the third hour when they crucified Him.” (Mark 15:25, BSB)
